buffer_layout: std430 byte offsets; host validates every offset, byte stride and maximum access before dispatch

common_rules.oob_status: shader atomically stores the first failing logical index; it never clamps to another element

logical_shapes.packed_weight: [N,K/2] bytes (safetensors header may call it I8)

mxfp4_linear.packing: byte i stores E2M1(k=2i) in low nibble and E2M1(k=2i+1) in high nibble

hc_split_sinkhorn.normalization_order: stable row softmax + eps, column, then 19 times row then column

sparse_attention.index_rules: -1 is padding; [0,N) is valid; every other value is rejected; duplicates are counted repeatedly
sparse_attention.sink_semantics: one virtual zero-value token per head whose logit contributes only to the denominator
sparse_attention.all_padding_extension: stable reference returns zero; official GPU kernel is not guaranteed for this case

claim_limit: 该 ABI 是未来 Vulkan shader 的 host/device 合同，不代表 shader 已实现或 RX 5700 XT 已获得任何速度。
